info.title: API.SH: NHL
info.description: The NHL API from API.SH: public NHL data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The picks of an NHL Draft: round, pick in round, overall pick, team, player name, position, country, height, weight, amateur club and league. One round or all.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-draft

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Draft year (1963 to this year); the latest draft by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
NHL Central Scouting's draft prospect rankings: name, position, shoots, height, weight, birth date and place, last amateur club and league, midterm and final rank. Four lists: North American and international skaters and goalies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-draft-rankings

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Draft year; the upcoming draft by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: NHL game box score and summary
get.description:
One game: teams with score and shots on goal, venue, broadcasts, game state and outcome, every skater's and goalie's line (goals, assists, points, plus-minus, hits, blocks, shots, faceoffs, time on ice; saves, save percentage), and the summary: scoring by period with goal details, penalties and the three stars.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-game

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Game id like `2025020100` from `/nhl/v1/scores` or `/nhl/v1/schedule`, or an nhl.com gamecenter link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The league leaders of a season: skaters (goals, assists, points, plus-minus, power-play goals, short-handed goals, faceoff percentage, penalty minutes, time on ice) or goalies (wins, shutouts, save percentage, goals-against average), each with player, team, position, headshot and value.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-leaders

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One category: skaters `goals`, `assists`, `points`, `plusMinus`, `goalsPp`, `goalsSh`, `faceoffLeaders`, `penaltyMins`, `toi`; goalies `wins`, `shutouts`, `savePctg`, `goalsAgainstAverage`. All by default.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season as `2025-26`, `20252026` or its first year `2025`; the current season by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

get.summary: NHL schedule for a week, or a team's season or month
get.description:
Without `team`: the seven days from `date` (default today), each with its games, plus the season's key dates. With `team`: the team's whole season (`season`) or one month (`month`). Each game has teams, scores when played, venue, start time, broadcasts and links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-schedule

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: First day of the week (YYYY-MM-DD); today by default.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season as `2025-26`, `20252026` or its first year `2025`; the current season by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Filter by conference or division.

get.description:
The goalie stats tables of nhl.com/stats, every report: wins, losses, save percentage, goals-against average, shutouts, saves by strength, rest days and more, per season, over a season range or game by game. Filter by team, nationality, rookies, minimum games; sort by any column. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nhl-stats-goalies

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season as `2025-26`, `20252026` or its first year `2025`; the current season by default.

parameters.name: season_to
parameters.description: Last season of a range (with `season` as the first).

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: `true` sums a season range into one row per player; `false` (default) gives one row per season.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Game-by-game rows from this date (YYYY-MM-DD), with `end_date`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last date of the game-by-game range (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Team abbreviation (`EDM`) to keep only that team.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by, e.g. `points`, `goals`, `wins`, `save_pct`, `hits`; the report's main column by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
